overloadPatches.semanticRole: Splits any previously-merged cells intersecting a range, element, or 4D Write Pro document back into their original cells.

discriminatedBy.note: single Object arg resolved as a range/element/document rather than a raw table reference

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Splits a rectangular block of previously-merged cells in a table, addressed by table reference and explicit start column/row (with optional column/row counts, default 1x1).

discriminatedBy.note: 3-5 arg form addressing a table by reference plus explicit coordinates

constraints: A cell is only affected if it was previously merged (horizontally, vertically, or both); unmerged cells are left unmodified.
columnCount and rowCount each default to 1 when omitted; if both are omitted, only the single intersected cell is targeted.
If startColumn+columnCount or startRow+rowCount exceed the table's dimensions, the split is clamped to the maximum possible columns/rows.
